stack.tailwind: none (no tailwind/postcss dep in apps/web/package.json; styling is hand-authored CSS under app/assets/css plus @nuxt/ui)

local_reimplementations.name: IpoStatusMatrix verification tiers
local_reimplementations.notes: 4-tile KPI/stat group (Confirmed/Reported/Watching/Unknown counts with tone) built from a local computed array; two of the four counts (5, 1) are hardcoded rather than derived from data (lines 23, 29). Good candidate shape for a shared kpi_stat_tile component.

local_reimplementations.name: IpoNewsFeed formatDate
local_reimplementations.notes: Local formatDate() (line 26) manually builds 'Mon DD HH:MM' from a MONTH_LABELS array and getUTCMonth/getUTCDate/getUTCHours instead of Intl.DateTimeFormat; narduk-libs ships no date formatter today either.

status_chip_badge.notes: Per-item <span data-status="..."> label driven by a statusLabels map; CSS-attribute-selector badge, not a component.

page_header.notes: Grep hit on 'PageHeader'/'SectionHeader' keyword; not independently verified as a distinct component.

kpi_stat_tile.notes: Inline 'donut' summary tile (active-source count + tone legend) at the top of a source list, lines ~10-19.

detail_list.notes: Simple <ul> of label/text items, no card chrome.
<ol> of source citations (publisher, external link, summary) plus the donut KPI described above.

date_time_format.notes: See local_reimplementations; hand-rolled formatDate() at line 26.

timeline_feed.notes: Ordered list of news items with publisher/date/title/description, sourced from server/api/spacex-news.get.ts (Google News RSS aggregation with a static fallback message).
Status-coded launch-event timeline list plus a decorative CSS 'radar' visualization.
Embeds X/Twitter feed widget; likely overlaps IpoXTimelineEmbed.

other.notes: Largest component; long-form editorial content, not a UI pattern.

top_extraction_candidates.name: StatMatrix / KPI tile group
top_extraction_candidates.why: Clean tone-coded 4-tile KPI group is exactly the shape narduk-libs has zero coverage for today; this app plus IpoSources' donut tile both reinvent small stat displays.

top_extraction_candidates.name: Shared relative/absolute date formatter
top_extraction_candidates.why: Manual month-label array + getUTC* formatting reimplements what Intl.DateTimeFormat (or a shared util) should do once for the whole estate.

top_extraction_candidates.name: Status-coded timeline/feed list
top_extraction_candidates.why: IpoTimeline and IpoNewsFeed both hand-roll an <ol> feed with per-item status/date/title/description; a shared TimelineFeed component would need item-status theming and a date formatter.

notes: Single-page marketing/tracker site (3 pages, all 14 components consumed exactly once from pages/index.vue) with NO table or pagination anywhere -- server/api/spacex-news.get.ts returns the full news list unpaginated with only a cache-control header. Despite depending on narduk-core, narduk-seo, narduk-analytics, and narduk-ui (0.1.2), the app uses ZERO narduk-libs UI components (no AppBreadcrumbs/AppTabs/AppEmptyState/NsFreshnessChip/etc. tag usage found) -- narduk-ui appears to be consumed only for tokens.css, not its instruments. This app directly depends on @nuxt/ui 4.6.0 (unlike borderwaitstat-us, which gets it transitively via narduk-core). No UI-relevant defect history in gh issues/PRs.
